verdict.rationale:
Marlin is explicitly designed as a built-in AI agent that users delegate entire research/strategy tasks to, working autonomously for hours with minimal human input beyond initial framing (docs-1, docs-9, docs-10, docs-16, docs-21). This directly matches the story of delegating tasks to a built-in assistant within the product.
Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification beyond vendor testimonials, and detail on interactive control while a task is delegated.
